name: reply-to-author
query: Draft a reply to the author on the dedupe PR. They pushed a fix for the merge key and asked if we're good to go.
why: A comment written back into a PR thread, reviewer direction.

name: respond-to-reviewers-on-own-pr
query: Two reviewers left comments on my PR. Help me answer them without sounding defensive.
why: The reverse direction: replying to reviewers on the user's own branch.

name: can-i-approve
query: Can I approve this? Their branch looks fine but another open PR touches the same staging model.
why: An approval note is a comment in the thread, and the merge-order collision is the skill's ownership question.

name: review-the-code-itself
query: Review this diff for bugs in the join logic. I'm not replying to anyone yet.
why: Reviewing code is separate; no comment is being written back.

name: pr-description
query: Write the PR description for my branch before I open it.
why: A description is not a comment in a thread.
